name: TileSkipper
aliases: Region-Adaptive Tile Pruning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: TileSkipper is a post-training systems adapter for 3D Gaussian Splatting that replaces a single scene-wide contribution cutoff with a static per-Gaussian cutoff policy to reduce tile-pair enumeration work without retraining the checkpoint.
summary: TileSkipper is a post-training adapter for 3D Gaussian Splatting that replaces scene-wide cutoffs with a region-adaptive, static per-Gaussian policy to reduce tile-pair enumeration without retraining.
